title: IntrospectTokenResponse
description: Introspection result of access or refresh tokens

active.description:
Whether the access token is active.

If `true`, the access token is valid and active. If `false`, the access token is invalid.

scope.description: The [scopes](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/scopes/) that the token has been granted.

client.description: The ID of the client that requested the token.

exp.description: The expiration time of the token, as a [Unix timestamp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time) in seconds.

iat.description: When the token was issued, as a [Unix timestamp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time) in seconds.

nbf.description: The "not before" time of the token, which specifies the time before which the access token most not be accepted, as a [Unix timestamp](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unix_time) in seconds.

jti.description: A unique ID for the access token.

sub.description:
The subject of the claim. This is the ID of the Canva user that the access token acts on behalf of.

This is an obfuscated value, so a single user has a unique ID for each app. If the same user authorizes another app, their ID in that other app is different.
